name: astra-db
description: Astra DB (DataStax / IBM) for coding agents: live database tools with interactive views, guarded writes and schema changes, vector and hybrid search, data-modeling and review skills, and 1,600+ idiomatic Data API snippets for Python, TypeScript, Java, C#, and Go.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect, query, and vector-search Astra DB from Codex — with idiomatic client code in five languages.
interface.longDescription: Astra DB (DataStax / IBM) and HCD for Codex. The astra-db MCP server gives live tools — database overview, collection and table schemas, find, vector and hybrid search, counts, guarded inserts/updates/deletes, and schema changes that ask before anything destructive — plus canonical Data API snippets. Skills cover setup ($astra-db:setup — connect with `npx -y @erichare/astra-mcp login`, no token in chat), diagnosis ($astra-db:doctor), code review, data modeling, and migrations. Credentials come from your project's .env, environment, or Astra CLI profile.
defaultPrompt: Connect this project to my Astra DB database
Show me what's in my Astra DB database
Create a vector collection for these documents and write Python code to search it
